stem: What is one important effect of the rhyme scheme of the poem?

options.label: F
options.text: It focuses the reader on the most important words in the poem.

options.label: G
options.text: It helps the reader visualize the problem the speaker experiences.

options.label: H
options.text: It creates a rhythm that emphasizes the quick actions in the poem.

options.label: J
options.text: It helps explain what spitting a cherry pit sounds like.
